title: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items in U.S. City Average
question: At what period does the CPI reach its highest visible value, and how much higher is it than the level at the start of 2020?

gold_answer.short_answer: February 2026; about 68.3 points higher than January 2020
gold_answer.long_answer: The highest visible value occurs in February 2026 at about 327.46. The CPI level at the start of 2020 is about 259.13 in January 2020, so the latest peak is about 68.3 points higher.
